title: Detection of Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore
author: Mengchen Shi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kchcst6

steps.title: Seed cells in 6‑well plates
steps.instruction: Seed 103 cells per well into each well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Induce apoptosis by serum starvation
steps.instruction: Incubate the seeded cells in serum‑free medium for 48 h to induce spontaneous apoptosis.

steps.title: Stain cells with GENMED solution
steps.instruction: Rinse cells with GENMED cleaning solution, add 1 mL GENMED staining solution, incubate 20 min at 37 °C in the dark, discard the supernatant, then wash twice with GENMED cleaning solution.

substeps.instruction: Rinse cells with GENMED cleaning solution
Add 1 mL GENMED staining solution and incubate 20 min at 37 °C in the dark
Wash cells twice with GENMED cleaning solution

steps.title: Observe MPTP changes by microscopy
steps.instruction: Monitor mitochondrial permeability transition pore changes using an inverted fluorescence microscope (Leica DMI4000B, Germany).
